terrain_soil.prompt: brown dirt ground, soft loose earth with fine grainy soil texture, a few tiny pebbles and dry grass bits, gentle colour variation
terrain_soil.negative: cracks, cracked, dry mud, rocks, cobblestones, plants

terrain_rich_soil.prompt: dark fertile topsoil seen from above, fine grained dark brown humus earth, soft and even, tiny specks of organic matter and a few small twigs, gentle colour variation
terrain_rich_soil.negative: cracks, cracked, dry mud, rocks, stones, pebbles, cobblestones, clumps, scales, plants, leaves

terrain_sand.prompt: pale golden beach sand ground, fine sand with soft wind ripples and a few tiny shell fragments and pebbles

terrain_gravel.prompt: fine gravel ground, thousands of tiny grey and tan pebbles and grit, small stones densely packed, low contrast

terrain_marsh.prompt: boggy marsh ground, dark olive wet mud with tufts of reeds and sedge grass and small dark puddles

terrain_rough_stone.prompt: rough natural grey bedrock floor, flat uneven stone surface with cracks, chips and small loose rubble

terrain_ice.prompt: smooth frozen lake surface seen from above, flat continuous pale blue-grey ice sheet with long thin white crack lines, faint frost streaks and small trapped bubbles, no plates, no snow piles
terrain_ice.note: procedural: python tools/art/ground_ice.py <raw_dir>/ice_proc.png 512 11 (the image model drew ice floes)
